selection.effect: Admit the exact-hash D65-S3 capability-local business ontology for integration epoch 001, pass G-D65-BUSINESS, and make D65-S4 eligible for separate DomainSpec v2 source authoring.
selection.reversibility: A later explicit business-ontology owner decision may supersede this admission; the exact candidate, evidence, and this decision remain immutable history.

admitted_business_meaning.canonical_truth: Canonical per-node and per-relation event histories calculate ontology state; snapshots and projections are derived evidence.
admitted_business_meaning.context_boundary: A governed Context consumes a projection bound to one exact selector, canonical event cut, projection profile, governance join, and challenge route; it is not an ontology truth source.
admitted_business_meaning.system_boundary: The business-system bridge admits required business and future-system endpoint contracts but no system endpoint, runtime component, DomainSpec realization, or implementation binding.
admitted_business_meaning.failure_boundary: Unknown selectors, event gaps, mixed cursors, digest mismatches, missing subjects, invalid governance joins, noncanonical replay sources, nondeterministic projections, and unresolved challenges fail closed.

non_effects: This decision does not change the immutable D65-S3 candidate package or its preselection evidence.
This decision does not author or admit D65-S4 DomainSpec v2 source.
This decision does not claim a system endpoint, system-runtime ontology, or business-system bridge realization.
This decision does not compile a graph, accept an implementation binding, mutate Rust code, or run a migration.
This decision does not authorize cutover, publication, release, deployment, credentials, destructive action, or external effects.
This decision does not make Invoke a predecessor, dependency, validator, admission source, or execution route.
claim_ceiling: Exact business-ontology owner admission for D65-S3 of one integration epoch. D65-S4 becomes eligible but remains blocked at G-D65-DOMAINSPEC-SOURCE until separately authored and admitted; no system realization, implementation, migration, publication, deployment, or external effect is authorized.
